note:
A SHARED FUNCTION AND AN AGREEMENT TEST DO NOT MAKE TWO CALLERS AGREE. They make the two callers COMPUTE alike. If each is handed a different copy of the data, they still diverge, and every artifact you would look at to check says the guard is in place.

THE INSTANCE. sluice-mouth.sh classified merge conflicts with sluice_is_regenerated_only -- the same function sluice-run.sh uses, deliberately shared, with a comment at the call site saying it MUST AGREE with the chamber and naming test-sluice.sh as what prevents a disagreement. Today the mouth said ADMIT and the chamber refused rc=10 on the same sha, three seconds apart.

The function was never wrong. It reads docs/generated-paths.txt from a ROOT DIRECTORY. The chamber passes its merge-product worktree; the mouth passed the repo toplevel. lefford main checkout was five commits behind origin/main, so its copy lacked the row declaring docs/audits/campaign-reconciliation.tsv hand-authored. The classifier fell back to the docs/audits/ DIRECTORY row, read artifacts, and admitted. Fast-forward the checkout, re-run the identical command, rc=1.

WHY THE TEST COULD NOT HAVE CAUGHT IT. Its cases vary the CONFLICT and hold the DECLARATION fixed -- one file, read by both callers. The axis the divergence lived on was never varied. Sharing the code made the logic identical and left the input unspecified.

THE GENERAL FORM, worth carrying past this bug: when you make two call sites share a function to guarantee they agree, ask what each one FEEDS it. A composition test has to vary the inputs independently, not just confirm the callers compute alike. Same shape as the flock/claim pair that were each green and could not see each other.

FIXED on tooling/mouth-cross-candidate (merging now): sluice_is_regenerated_only_at asks the question of a git ref. The mouth requires BOTH origin/main and the candidate to declare a path artifacts-authored, so it stays at least as strict as the chamber in either direction, and a ref that cannot produce the file fails closed. Regression test varies the declaration and is mutation-proved -- restoring the working-tree read fails that assertion alone.

OPERATOR HABIT THIS ALSO ARGUES FOR: keep the lefford main checkout fast-forwarded. It was five behind because the chamber pushes origin/main and nothing moves the checkout. That is now cosmetic for the mouth, but it was load-bearing for three hours today.
